items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: They couldn't have made Major Bowes' Amateur Hour.

ctx.x: These cats -- they don't do nothing. You get one of those chicks, with the $3.00 hair, get a $3.00 guitar and she go out and sing the water's wet, the wind is blowing and right away I see a guy like Merv Griffin, Mike Douglas and

them guys, how many gold records you got. I got 15, 20. They must be giving them away like handbills. They couldn't have made Major Bowes' Amateur Hour. They don't know when the music start, by the colored. They ain't saying nothing. It was put up or shut up. You either had it or you didn't have it. If you didn't have it, you just move aside.

Wasn't no in between, because these people know no talent, as I said, music is our heritage, dancing. Music and dancing, ain't picking no cotton, our heritage. Rhythm is our heritage. You understand what I mean, all them people singing. They caught it from Negro churches. They don't know nothing about that.
